title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Multisectoral Emergency Response & Resilience Building of IDP and Host Communities in Gogrial East and Tonj North Counties, Warrap State programme implemented by Trócaire, aims to contribute to Outcome 4.1: The most vulnerable/marginalised women, men, girls and boys in the communities affected by crisis can meet their basic needs. The activities and objective include, vulnerable households provided with food & NFI kits, WASH infrastructure rehabilitated, handpump mechanics and water user committees trained and, school hygiene clubs strengthened. So, the vulnerable in the communities are utilising humanitarian assistance that is principled, timely, high quality and in line with their needs and priorities. Programmes are in partnership with Hope Agency for Relief and Development (HARD) ---- The principal focus of this objective is:- Improve access to more diversified nutritional diets and food and improve the nutritional status of a target population- Improve access to WASH and nutrition knowledge- ensure that women and girls benefit equally with men from the activity to compensate for past discrimination
